entities.name: PDU session type

entities.name: PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure where the UE requests to establish a new PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session establishment request message
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request establishment of a new PDU session.

relations.description: The PDU session establishment request message contains the PDU session type IE.
The PDU session establishment procedure includes sending the PDU session establishment request message.
The PDU session establishment procedure requires the PDU session type IE to be included in the request message.
